description: Bornes de recharge pour SOWATT (IRVE) - 20240416 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SOWATT SOLUTIONS. This dataset meets the specifications of the "static EVIR" schema available on schema.data.gouv.fr It includes a list of all publicly accessible charging points owned by Sowatt Solutions. Coverage: SOWATT SOLUTIONS. The portal shows the English title as "Charging stations for electric vehicles SOWATT (IRVE) - 20240416" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is SOWATT SOLUTIONS. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-06-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
